content: Swagger UI has no built-in i18n: canonical open feature request swagger-api/swagger-ui#4776 (Add internationalization support); community localization threads (SmartBear) confirm only hacks exist (override strings after bundle load, DOM patching, forks like knife4j). The 5th surface ('Swagger') can only localize the skill-owned chrome (title, surrounding HTML, html lang attribute) - the widget's own labels (Authorize, Try it out) stay English.
